# Cncf Casdoor Reviewer

Review Casdoor using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Casdoor is an open-source UI-first identity access management (IAM) / Single-Sign-On (SSO) platform with web UI supporting OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and CAS.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
